[element-open-access]
=== `<open-access>` Open Access

A container element to hold metadata concerning the open access provisions that apply to a work (for example, which model of charging was used or who paid the open access charges) or the funding information that provided the open access provisions.

#### Usage/Remarks
This tag is for in-line discussions of open access that cannot readily be captured in the <<element-license,`<license>`>>, or that are in addition to the information there. If there is a paragraph in the text that mentions that this is an open access document, there should be a license element that describes it.

#### Related Elements

The <<element-ali-free_to_read,`<ali:free_to_read>`>> is a simple indication of the status of the standard that does not make any statements about additional reuse rights or restrictions.
